description: A range is a tag set in a tag term and in a condition, with ∪, ∩, ∖, ⊆ and =. `..` binds tighter than every other operator, so 'a'..'c' ∪ 'x' is four tags (engine §1, §10).
grammar:
%rule text $c(item)
%conditions
  tags($c) = 'a'..'c' ∪ 'x',
  'b'..'b' ⊆ tags($c),
  tags($c) ∩ 'x'..'z' = 'x',
  tags($c) ∖ 'a'..'b' = 'c' ∪ 'x',
  'a'..'z' ⊈ tags($c)
%rule item 'q' <'a'..'c' ∪ 'x'>
